data.name: Karrah
data.long_meaning: The name Karrah is believed to have originated from the Greek and Latin languages, where it means 'maiden' or 'pure one'. In the Christian faith, this name is often given to girls as a symbol of innocence and purity. In the Bible, there are no direct references to the name Karrah, but it is thought to have spiritual connections to the virtue of chastity.
